summary.method: XY-cost order-preserving dynamic time warping; one lowest-distance matched GUI sample per robot sample. Heading is evaluated after XY alignment. Includes first post-completion pose. Timing comparison uses common elapsed-time interval only.
caveats: Current upstream GUI simulator revision, not verified against the team desktop GUI version.
Simulation is not real-hardware accuracy or PID validation.
Dynamic time warping removes timing differences and is an optimistic geometric alignment, not proof of identical segment/event behavior.
